notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone

We have released update 1.7.

Now the CSTO campaign is fully available.

3 new maps have been added to multiplayer.

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have released update 1.6.

The first 4 missions for the CSTO campaign are now available, as well as multiplayer in a very early test mode.

How multiplayer works:
[olist] On the game servers, bots play instead of absent players.
 When a player connects, he replaces one of the bots.
 If a player leaves the game, he will be immediately replaced by a bot.
 If the connection with a player is interrupted by accident, then after 2 minutes, the player's units will be temporarily controlled by a substitute bot. And after 5 minutes the player will be finally replaced by the bot.
 In the next round, the faction rotates.
 Bots have specific nicknames of 2 words.
[/olist]

What's missing in multiplayer at the moment:
chat or other communication system;
accounting for points, victories and defeats;
ability to change sides;
ability to create your own server.

For balance, when completing the first 4 missions of the CSTO campaign, 36 points for upgrades will be temporary available.

What are other news:

 Skirmish mode can now be played as any faction.
 We have added machine translation in 9 languages. Later we will make a more correct translation.
 Fixed various bugs.
 Optimized RAM usage.

notes.title: Major update 1.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone

First, we must apologize for the delay in this update.
Initially, for the full release, we planned to make only the second campaign and the online mode.
However, when we analyzed reviews and let's plays, we came to the conclusion that the game needs fundamental improvements.
Over time, this update has been overgrown with more and more innovations, and finally it is ready.

What's new.

We have significantly reworked the gameplay, added new units and upgrades, changed squad management.
We've also reworked the campaign to include a new defensive mission type and more conquest missions.

1. Units and squads.

Instead of recruiting a squad from individual units, we made a system of ready-made squads. Hiring them has become much easier and faster.

Squads can now gain experience and activate perks during a mission. For example, you can give the squad a first aid kit, more health, C4 explosives, "luck", etc.

Lifetime XP is also accumulated for the entire squad class. It allows you to open varios upgrades for the entire class.

2. New game mechanics.

We have implemented new mechanics and weapons for units, for example:

 Repair/healing
 ATGM Javelin
 Mortar (now it will be an infantryman with a mortar)
 ATGM on BMP
 Coaxial machine gun
 Long range rifle
 Active tank protection
 Reconnaissance drone
 Mobile spawn point

More of the improvements:

 on some captured control points, units are now healed automatically
 speed of a group of units is now the same for all


3. Campaign missions.

5 missions have been completely reworked.
A new type of mission has been added in which you need to hold out on the defensive for a certain time. And also there are more missions in the Conquest mode.

4. Management of squads.

We have added the ability to manage squads like in classic RTS:

 attack specific unit
 movement without stopping
 hold position
 multiple AI modes
 order chains


Squads can be grouped for faster control.

Have fun!
